shared_elements: standing human figures in profile, in long robes
file/procession of figures one behind another, all facing the same direction
horizontal register of figures bounded by a decorative band
relief-carved wall panel with repeated figures
justification: Both show a horizontal register of closely spaced, robed, bearded figures in strict profile marching in single file in one direction, wearing tall headgear and carrying objects, set above/below a running ornamental band — a fairly specific processional scheme rather than a generic human figure. The chief difference in content is scope: A additionally depicts architecture (columns, stairway parapets), a lion-attacking-bull group and an inscription, and shows the figures as tiny elements of a whole monument, whereas B depicts only the file of figures at large scale with an added gesture of one figure touching/addressing another.
